items.title: Add documented Loom video support
items.description: Make public Loom share URLs an explicitly supported transcription source across the standalone CLI, Make convenience wrapper, and user documentation. Preserve the ADR 0004 pinned yt-dlp strategy, add deterministic regression coverage that Loom share URLs use the URL pipeline unchanged, and verify the supplied public Loom fixture end to end.
items.completionEvidence: Verified the supplied public Loom share end to end with the pinned bundled downloader and native Whisper, producing 4,135 transcript bytes and 63 segments. Added deterministic CLI routing and help coverage, named Loom across user/API/OpenAPI documentation, validated quiet mode with zero stderr bytes, validated Swagger YAML, and passed all non-handler package tests plus full vet.

items.title: Add quiet-by-default transcribe output
items.description: Make the transcribe CLI print only transcript text on successful default runs so terminal output and clipboard pipelines stay clean. Add an opt-in verbose mode that restores progress, summaries, ffmpeg command details, native Whisper diagnostics, and detailed downloader errors while retaining concise errors by default.
items.completionEvidence: Added quiet-by-default CLI and engine output, GNU-style --verbose/-v diagnostics, a documented make build-transcribe target, executable-relative model discovery for direct CLI use, a retained VERBOSE=1 Make convenience wrapper, synchronized native Whisper and ffmpeg logging controls, concise default failures, updated usage documentation and ADR 0006, regression tests, all non-handler Go package tests and full vet passes, CGO build verification, and cached native smoke tests proving zero stderr bytes in quiet mode.

items.title: Diagnose handlers test startup hang
items.description: The handlers package test binary hangs before emitting its first verbose test event and does not honor the requested 60-second Go test timeout. Diagnose package initialization or external-resource startup so `go test ./...` completes reliably. All other repository packages pass.

items.title: Fix YouTube Shorts 403 Forbidden download error
items.description: YouTube Shorts downloads fail with HTTP Error 403: Forbidden due to YouTube forcing SABR streaming protocol. go-ytdlp v1.2.7 bundles outdated yt-dlp that doesn't handle SABR. Fix: update go-ytdlp from v1.2.7 to v1.3.1 which bundles yt-dlp 2026.02.21 with improved YouTube support.

items.title: Add CLI transcribe target to Makefile
items.description: Add a `make transcribe URL=...` target for quick one-off transcriptions without starting the HTTP server. Extends existing examples/local-files/transcribe.go to handle any URL (YouTube, Instagram, local files) and adds Makefile integration.

items.title: MCP Server + ChatGPT Apps SDK Integration
items.description: Add an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server to OmniTranscripts to enable ChatGPT integration via the OpenAI Apps SDK. Allows users to submit YouTube URLs and get transcripts for summarization directly in ChatGPT. Includes: implementing MCP server with mark3labs/mcp-go, exposing transcribe_url and get_media_duration tools, configuring HTTP/SSE transport, and documenting ChatGPT app registration.

items.title: Fix yt-dlp subprocess leak causing system degradation
items.description: yt-dlp subprocesses are leaking during normal operation, resulting in hundreds to thousands of idle processes remaining alive. Root cause: All yt-dlp invocations use context.Background() which never cancels, preventing subprocess termination on request cancellation, timeout, or error conditions. Fix requires adding context propagation to engine/engine.go and lib/transcription.go, binding contexts to HTTP request lifecycle, and implementing proper timeouts.

items.title: README local files positioning + file upload API
items.description: Fix README positioning that anchors users to YouTube/URLs. Add multipart/form-data file upload support to POST /transcribe endpoint. Update tagline, add Local Files section, update Features list, add file upload examples, and add FAQ entry.

items.title: Test verification and API marketplace preparation
items.description: Run comprehensive tests to verify production readiness, fix stale VideoTranscript naming references, create API marketplace tracking list, and prepare RapidAPI integration (OpenAPI spec, pricing tiers, documentation).

items.title: Rename VideoTranscript to OmniTranscripts
items.description: Rename project from VideoTranscript to OmniTranscripts and formally expand scope from library-only to combined library + HTTP API. Includes: updating Go module name to 'omnitranscripts', creating engine/ package for public library consumption, adding minimal TranscriptionError with stage-specific errors, documenting GitHub repo rename steps, updating all documentation and references.

items.title: Harden Dashboard Identifiers and Subprocess Inputs
items.description: The dashboard accepts an unvalidated media URL, derives a fallback VideoID, interpolates persisted VideoID values into transcript filesystem paths and a pgrep regular expression, and passes the URL to yt-dlp. exec.Command does not invoke a shell, so the original command-injection wording is imprecise; the actionable risks are path traversal from untrusted persisted identifiers, regex/process-match manipulation, unsafe URL schemes, and collisions for non-YouTube sources. Validate HTTP(S) media URLs, derive bounded safe identifiers, reject unsafe persisted identifiers before filesystem use, quote dynamic regex text, and terminate yt-dlp option parsing before the URL.
items.completionEvidence: Added tested HTTP(S) URL validation, deterministic safe media identifiers, guarded path construction, validated persisted identifiers, quoted process patterns, derived log paths, and yt-dlp option termination. Targeted tests, vet, repository build, explicit dashboard build/vet, backlog validation, and diff checks pass.

items.title: Implement Duration Parsing
items.description: The parseDuration() function in engine/engine.go:189-191 and lib/transcription.go:268-270 returns a hardcoded value of 120 seconds instead of actually parsing the duration. This affects the sync/async processing decision logic. Remediation: Implement actual duration parsing from yt-dlp output format (e.g., 'HH:MM:SS' or 'MM:SS').

items.title: Add Unit Tests for Core Packages
items.description: Several core packages have no test files: config/ (no unit tests for configuration loading), engine/ (no unit tests for transcription engine), jobs/ (no unit tests for job queue operations). Remediation: Add unit tests for these packages, especially for configuration validation and job state transitions.

items.title: Replace Debug Logging with Structured Logging
items.description: Production code contains numerous fmt.Printf and fmt.Println statements instead of using structured logging: lib/transcription.go (15+ instances), engine/engine.go (10+ instances), web-dashboard.go (5+ instances including console.log in embedded JS). Remediation: Replace with structured logging (e.g., log.Printf with proper log levels, or a logging library like zap/zerolog).

items.title: Add clipboard support to transcribe CLI
items.description: Add make transcribe-clip target that automatically copies transcript to clipboard (cross-platform: macOS pbcopy, Linux xclip/xsel). Enables quick clipboard workflows for transcript extraction.

items.title: Investigate a smoother transcribe workflow for YouTube 403 failures
items.description: Determine how the make transcribe CLI should avoid duplicate progress output, detect or recover from stale bundled yt-dlp failures, and present actionable diagnostics when YouTube SABR or HTTP 403 behavior prevents downloading.
items.completionEvidence: Confirmed duplicate status ownership, reproduced the supplied URL failure with bundled yt-dlp 2026.02.21, verified the checksum-matched upstream 2026.08.19 binary succeeds, and initially verified go-ytdlp v1.3.6 with yt-dlp 2026.07.04 using a partial --test download. Follow-up full-transfer verification found July still fails and corrected the implementation target to the wrapper commit pinning August.

items.title: Smooth transcribe diagnostics and refresh pinned yt-dlp
items.description: Update go-ytdlp from v1.3.1 to the exact wrapper commit pinning yt-dlp 2026.08.19, retain DisableSystem and version pinning under ADR 0004, remove the Makefile's duplicate Transcribing line so the CLI owns progress, classify stale/SABR/HTTP-403 download failures into one concise actionable diagnostic that identifies the bundled version and avoids suggesting yt-dlp -U, and add deterministic tests for output ownership and error classification. Add dependency-update automation so platform extractor drift is detected earlier.
items.completionEvidence: Pinned the wrapper commit containing yt-dlp 2026.08.19, retained DisableSystem, added typed compatibility failures and concise CLI diagnostics, removed duplicate Make progress, added weekly dependency monitoring, and completed both reported URLs end to end.

items.title: Fix current YouTube transcribe 403 regression
items.description: Implement the promoted downloader-refresh and CLI-diagnostics work after reproducing hYRdmo7M-ng with pinned yt-dlp 2026.02.21, finding 2026.07.04 still fails a full transfer, and verifying pinned 2026.08.19 succeeds. Preserve ADR 0004 pinning, remove duplicate progress output, and add typed, actionable compatibility errors with regression coverage.
items.completionEvidence: Reproduced the old full-download failure, proved July still fails full transfer despite passing --test, verified August completes WAV extraction, and reran both original make transcribe workflows through successful native Whisper transcription.
